scope: Production ecology creates deer on explicitly tagged fixture ground; fixture relocates player to it. Production DamageAnimal, hunt reward, five-second Act loot, SavePoint and LoadPoint used. Repeated collected-node loads cannot recreate loot; pending-node rollback removes future inventory then yields original amount. Separate UE process reads both original copied nodes, retries loot, repeats disk loads and verifies exact inventory and full nature identity/generation/reward/deadline state. Actual-map trail positions/times are covered separately. No natural tracking route, combat-input or visual playtest credit.
